sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
NUSKHE BY PARAS PIGMENTATION FACE WASH

✽Apply a small amount of Nuskhe By Pigmentation Face Wash on a wet face.

✽Gently massage your fingertips in a circular motion.

✽Rinse off with water and pat dry.

================================

PIGMENTATION PAPAYA ANTI BLEMISH CREAM

✽Apply pigmentation papaya anti-blemish cream after washing you face with pigmentation facewash generally at night before sleeping.

✽Massage for 5-10 minutes.

✽Wash your face in the morning with normal water.

Note: Slight irritation is normal, but if it increases it's recommended to wash the application immediately.

===============================

PIGMENTATION MASK

✽Apply all over the face and neck region.

✽Leave it for 10-15 minutes and then wash it with lukewarm water or with a towel dipped in warm water.

✽Use a refreshing skin toner for a soothing effect.

Note- Use this mask once or twice a week according to your convenience.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Uneven skin tone, dark spots, and dullness don’t happen overnight—and they don’t go away with just one product.
That’s why the Xtreme Pigmentation Combo ✨ is designed as a complete 3-step routine to target pigmentation from multiple levels.

This combo includes a Facewash, Mask, and Cream—working together to cleanse, treat, and repair your skin for visible results over time. 💧

Start with the Pigmentation Facewash 🍋, enriched with Papaya, Lemon Extract, and Neem Oil to gently cleanse, remove buildup, and support brighter-looking skin. Follow it with the Pigmentation Mask 🌿, powered by Vitamin C, Turmeric, and Aloe Vera to help reduce dullness and improve overall skin clarity. Finish with the Pigmentation Cream ✨, formulated with Licorice Root and nourishing oils to support even skin tone and long-lasting hydration.

⭐ Achievements 

-> Trusted by Thousands of Customers – Consistently chosen by users dealing with pigmentation, dullness, and uneven skin tone

-> High Repeat Purchase Rate – Customers come back for visible improvements and routine-friendly results

-> Top Performing Pigmentation Combo – One of the most preferred complete routines in its category

-> Positive Customer Feedback – Appreciated for its gradual yet noticeable skin clarity and brightness

-> Multi-Step Routine Success – Designed as a complete system, not a single-product solution

-> Growing Community Favorite – Widely shared and recommended across skincare users

-> Consistent Results with Regular Use – Known for delivering better outcomes with proper routine follow-up

The textures are lightweight and easy to use, making it simple to follow daily.

NOTE:- 

1) People with sensitive skin are advised to perform a patch test. If a rash, redness, or itching appears, stop using it.

2) The colour formulation is caused by natural ingredients, which is completely normal and indicates that the product is performing well.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 1. What is this combo used for?

This combo helps reduce pigmentation, dark spots, uneven skin tone, and dullness.

2. What does “triple action” mean?

It means the face wash cleanses, the mask treats, and the cream helps maintain results for brighter-looking skin.

3. Can I use all three products daily?

You can use the face wash daily. The mask can be used 2–3 times a week, and the cream can be used daily.

4. Is this suitable for all skin types?

Yes, it is suitable for most skin types. Do a patch test if you have very sensitive skin.

5. Does it help with dark spots and pigmentation?

Yes, regular use helps reduce the appearance of dark spots and uneven skin tone.

6. How long will it take to see results?

You may notice fresher skin in a few days. Visible improvement in pigmentation can be seen with regular use over a few weeks.

7. Can men also use this combo?

Yes, this pigmentation care range is suitable for both men and women.
